away_injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.
Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.
